"use client"

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { normalizeAdminApiError, type AdminApiError, type AdminNotifier } from "@/components/admin/admin-runtime"

export interface ResourceMutationAdapter<TInput, TResult> {
  execute: (input: TInput) => Promise<TResult>
  invalidate?: (result: TResult, input: TInput) => Promise<void> | void
}

export function useResourceMutation<TInput, TResult>({ adapter, notify, successMessage = "Saved successfully." }: {
  adapter: ResourceMutationAdapter<TInput, TResult>
  notify?: AdminNotifier
  successMessage?: string
}) {
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false)
  const pendingRef = useRef(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState<AdminApiError | null>(null)
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false)
  const mutate = useCallback(async (input: TInput) => {
    if (pendingRef.current) throw new Error("A mutation is already in progress.")
    pendingRef.current = true
    setPending(true)
    setError(null)
    setSuccess(false)
    try {
      const result = await adapter.execute(input)
      await adapter.invalidate?.(result, input)
      setSuccess(true)
      notify?.({ type: "success", title: successMessage })
      return result
    } catch (cause) {
      const normalized = normalizeAdminApiError(cause)
      setError(normalized)
      notify?.({ type: "error", title: "Operation failed", description: normalized.message })
      throw normalized
    } finally {
      pendingRef.current = false
      setPending(false)
    }
  }, [adapter, notify, successMessage])
  return { mutate, pending, error, success, reset: () => { setError(null); setSuccess(false) } }
}
